request: Analyze GSE164890 for PMID 35456380 (RNA Sequencing of Whole Blood Defines the Signature of High Intensity Exercise at Altitude in Elite Speed Skaters): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, globin-depleted whole blood, strand-specific polyA, HiSeq 4000 (S2.3.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 7 elite female speed skaters, day 18 of altitude camp (1850 m), whole blood before and after one intense skating bout; 14 samples, none excluded (S2.1.p1, S2.1.p2, S2.3.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Within-donor change in whole-blood gene expression after vs before an acute intense exercise bout at altitude (after - before)
planned_contrasts: after vs before exercise, paired by donor (FIG1, S3.2.p2; paper: 2516 up, 1542 down = 4058 DEGs at FDR<0.1)
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors on RSEM per-gene counts (S2.5.p1); rlog + ComBat only for plots
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.18.1, design ~ donor + exercise, on RSEM gene-level counts (S2.5.p1, FIG1)
final.paper_results: 2516 up, 1542 down (S3.2.p2); 104 up / 58 down >2-fold; named genes MARC1, PHOSPHO1 up (S3.5.p5-6), MYC and TP53 down (S3.3.p2), PPBP platelet marker up (S3.5.p4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Single paired before/after design. S2.5.p1 states DESeq2 on RSEM per-gene table retaining FDR<0.1; FIG1 caption states 'donor + exercise' design and 10% FDR; S3.2.p1 justifies donor covariate. No fold-change cutoff for the headline DEG count (the |log2FC|>=0.5 and TPM>=10 filters in S3.5.p4 are a later prioritization of altitude-specific genes, not the DE threshold).

checks: 14 samples = 7 skaters x before/after as in S2.3.p1
GEO tissue 'whole blood (globin-depleted)', Homo sapiens, RSEM v1.2.31 in data_processing matches S2.4.p1

ownership.reasoning: Paper deposits its data under GSE164890 (S2.3.p1, S10.p1); GEO sample titles 'Skater N - before/after exercise' and RSEM processing match the methods.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (1before, 1after, ...) equal the GEO 'description' field exactly for 14/14 samples (inspect alignment_keys). Subject number and time point parsed from that key; consistent with titles 'Skater N - before/after exercise' and the 'time point' characteristic.

matrix.reasoning: File GSE164890_rsem.genes.counts.tsv.gz: RSEM expected counts (S2.4.p1; data_processing RSEM v1.2.31), 94.5% integer values with fractional remainder, max 5.6e5 - consistent with RSEM estimated counts, not TPM (separate TPM file exists). Paper fed this per-gene RSEM table to DESeq2 (S2.5.p1); rounding to integers is the standard way to use RSEM expected counts in DESeq2.

candidates.reason_rejected: length-normalized; paper's DESeq2 input was the count table

final.paper_input: RSEM per-gene expression table (counts) into DESeq2 (S2.5.p1)

design.subject: subject
design.reasoning: One factor (time: before/after exercise) measured twice within each of 7 donors; the paper's estimand is the within-donor exercise effect (FIG1 'donor + exercise'). No other grouping column exists in GEO metadata.

covariates.name: subject
covariates.disposition: blocking factor (donor fixed effect), as in the paper's donor + exercise design

covariance.reasoning: S3.2.p1 shows a strong donor effect on PCA and the paper models donor as a covariate (FIG1). Each donor contributes one pre and one post sample, so subject is crossed with, not confounded by, time.

deviations: RSEM expected counts rounded to integers before DESeq2 (paper does not state rounding; DESeq2 requires integers)
pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2 v1.18.1

method.reasoning: Paper route DESeq2 ~ donor + exercise on RSEM counts is executable on the deposited count table after rounding (S2.5.p1, FIG1).

threshold.reasoning: S2.5.p1 'retaining genes with FDR < 0.1'; FIG1 'reported at 10% FDR'; no fold-change cutoff for the DEG list. Audit at padj<0.05 is a separate labelled comparison rule.

caveats: pydeseq2 vs R DESeq2 1.18 independent filtering/dispersion details may shift counts
altitude-specific filtering against 7 microarray datasets (S3.5) not reproduced
no sea-level control: the estimand is exercise at altitude, not altitude itself (S3.5.p1)

study.reasoning: Paper reports 2516 up + 1542 down = 4058 DEGs at FDR<0.1 (S3.2.p2). Named genes: MARC1, PHOSPHO1 up (S3.5.p5-6), PPBP up (S3.5.p4), MYC and TP53 down (S3.3.p2).

discrepancies.paper: RSEM per-gene table into DESeq2 (rounding not stated)
discrepancies.data: RSEM expected counts with fractional values

discrepancies.paper: title frames 'exercise at altitude'; altitude-specific genes via cross-study filter (S3.5)
discrepancies.data: only pre/post at altitude; no sea-level arm

executions.name: time_post_vs_pre
executions.reasoning: Paper's DESeq2 ~ donor + exercise, post vs pre, FDR 0.1

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports Hallmark ORA and fGSEA (S3.3, FIG2); Hallmark only here (CP collection not available in runner).
